silumanBabi.timing: Attach the fixed grant to the actual Babi result reaction; no new wheel. Animal Transformation remains a separate completion grant.
silumanBabi.definitionAuthority: lelembut-events-design.json; same Nyolong definition as Tuyul
silumanBabi.mainPowerNone: Retain this owned power and resolve pending normal Power Mastery.
silumanBabi.laterBabi: If another Babi component for the same Siluman component is allowed later, retain the original grant and add provenance/binding; no mastery respin.

raceNoRepeat.status: User-confirmed exclusion of previous character races; all previously committed selection families is the explicit design interpretation.
raceNoRepeat.scope: Every character-identity race draw/respin, including Skeleton/Zombie origin and proposed Hybrid parent or host selections.
raceNoRepeat.key: Canonical selectionFamilyId / option.familyId; enforce at the level selected by the race-family wheel.
raceNoRepeat.state: raceSelectionHistory[] and usedRaceFamilyIds[] shared by the whole character across all origin/parent branches.
raceNoRepeat.initial: The first main race result is committed to history before its subtype or other race events run. Selecting Skeleton/Zombie therefore already marks Lelembut used.
raceNoRepeat.beforeDraw: Intersect existing caller eligibility with familyId not in usedRaceFamilyIds. Disable all used sections before drawing; do not sample them then reroll.
raceNoRepeat.weights: Use user-specified weights where present, otherwise base weight 1. Apply approved modifiers and normalize over eligible positive weights. All previously selected race families have probability zero; exclusion dominates modifiers.
raceNoRepeat.commit: Atomically append invocation/role/family/component provenance and add the selected family to usedRaceFamilyIds before dispatching any child race events.
raceNoRepeat.resume: A resumed committed invocation reuses its result. It does not apply the exclusion to itself and reroll; history and consumed-event keys restore atomically.
raceNoRepeat.bounded: Each new identity-family result strictly enlarges the used set. At most the number of unique eligible catalog families can commit (17 in the current main pool), so race-family cycles cannot repeat indefinitely.
raceNoRepeat.emptyPool: A required draw with no eligible positive-weight candidate is an explicit configuration error. Never reset history, restore used sections, silently skip, or reroll a committed result.
raceNoRepeat.subtypes: Selecting a subtype/form is resolving the already-selected family, not selecting that family again. Known lore ancestry is not added to history unless it was actually selected by an identity race wheel.
raceNoRepeat.referenceBoundary: Vampire prey is a reference to a target, not a character race acquisition; it keeps its existing separate reference contract and does not consume personal race history.
raceNoRepeat.archetypeBoundary: Race no-repeat applies only to identity-family draws. Archetype is evaluated once after the complete Race tree; Raksasa skips and registers no second-Archetype ticket under policy 1.0.0. Preserve older committed journals under their original policy.

layers: selected Lelembut type and committed fixed grants/tickets/modifiers
actual source/prey race result when reached
actual Cursed power result if reached
contextContract.asOf: Record source invocation/component scope for each layer; reaction sees committed facts only.
contextContract.fixedGrants: Attach fixed power/penalty reveals to their source reaction; no random spin is fabricated.
contextContract.powerMastery: All early grants remain owned for normal Power Mastery, even if main Power is None. No power enchantment.
contextContract.funnyResult: Narrator jokes or memes do not classify gameplay funny-result outcomes. Shrek bonuses require existing approved actual-result catalog tags.

openBalance: Complete inherited origin body/component compatibility and declared family profiles; no-repeat guards and event-inheritance decisions are settled.
Equal Lelembut origin/type, main race and Cursed base weights confirmed; optional user overrides
Detailed scopes, numeric scales and limits; max base Durability vs final guarantee and late acquisition
Later probability/eligibility profiles for committed race and ability traits
Lelembut body reference profiles for global Size
Repeated identical power definitions from independent sources: merge/exclusion policy
Detailed wealth/resources, consumption, child protection, organ targets and transformation activation rules

narrationStyle.status: User-confirmed funny Gen Z Indonesian style; individual lines are editable examples.
narrationStyle.voice: Santai, lucu, kayak temen lagi nge-roast hasil gacha karakter. Campur Indonesia dan English yang familiar.
narrationStyle.labels: Pertahankan nama yang sudah enak dipakai. Ngesot tetap Ngesot; Mukbang tetap Mukbang. Penjelasan makna tinggal di scope/konteks AI, tanpa tambahan terjemahan baku pada label layar.
narrationStyle.delivery: Utamakan satu kalimat reaksi dan satu punchline pendek. Pakai slang secukupnya: dapet, mentok, build, gacha, bocil; jangan setiap kalimat dipaksa pakai slang yang sama.
narrationStyle.facts: Konteks fakta terstruktur menjadi sumber kebenaran; celetukan memakai hasil yang sudah tercatat dan tidak memberi power/stat/kejadian baru.
narrationStyle.humorMechanics: Contoh narasi bukan tag funny-result, tidak mengubah odds, dan tidak memicu bonus Shrek sendiri.
narrationStyle.examples: Boleh divariasikan dengan callback dari hasil sebelumnya; contoh bukan skrip wajib atau fakta kejadian tambahan.
